about: Shadow-mark matrix (hub_shadow_check/mark_matrix.gd): every player kind and enemy type, every idle/walk/attack frame on disk; per foot, grounded attaches within 1 cell of its mark pin, raised shows a gap matching its lift; mark mask has no detached chunk or enclosed hole at the cell scale. Planted offset pin, glued raised foot and stray chunk must each FAIL. Contact sheet and rows: _logs/mark-matrix/.
